title: Apollo 15 landing site (Moon)

place.label: Hadley Rille, the Moon
place.basis: Latitude and longitude as published by NSSDCA, referenced to the DE421 Mean Earth/Polar Axis lunar reference frame

measures.label: Latitude and longitude on the Moon

facts.text: NSSDCA's Apollo table lists Apollo 15: launched 26 July 1971, landed 30 July 1971 at Hadley Rille (26.132 N, 3.633 E).

tiers.everyday: Apollo 15 landed on the Moon on 30 July 1971 in Hadley Rille. NASA lists the site at 26.132 N, 3.633 E on the Moon.
tiers.student: NSSDCA's Apollo table lists a launch on 26 July 1971, 19.13 hours of moonwalk time, a 27.9 km traverse and 77.31 kg of samples. Coordinates use the DE421 Mean Earth/Polar Axis frame.

unknowns: IAU Gazetteer name for this landing point: not looked up [UNKNOWN] (only the Apollo 11 name was checked)
